env.note: THE SPECIMEN THIS FIELD EXISTS FOR (#4837). Until #4704 this row was `live` on the consumer pointer alone and the verdict was FALSE: the cited line really did call filterByEnv, but none of the SIX call sites that build a SeedLoaderRequest (app boot, per-org replay, hot reload, package apply, draft publish, marketplace install) passed `env` — so `config.env` was permanently undefined, filterByEnv returned its input on its first line, and `dataset.env` was never read at all. `seed-loader.test.ts` passed throughout, because it supplies `config.env` itself: it exercised a mechanism nothing fed. #4704 fixed the wiring INSIDE `load()`, the one funnel every seeding path goes through, so call site seven cannot reopen the hole. Re-verified 2026-08-09 with both sides cited.
